'''Tivlik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] as his [[Spice/Legends|spice]] buyer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When one of Nem'ro's [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] was shot down near [[Nem'ro's Palace]], Tivlik was pleased to find that an individual gathered the lost containers of spice and delivered them to him.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tivlik appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the mission "Spicecraft Down" on Hutta.<ref name="TOR" />
